rows.read_by: claude-opus-5 reading render_page.swift output, page rotated upright, at scale 3 and 8
rows.proof: the 23 fiscal years foot to the printed TOTAL column: principal 33,256,561 and MWPAT admin fees 8,378 tie EXACTLY, and interest, principal & interest and total debt miss by $1-$2 because the page prints DISPLAYED whole dollars over figures carrying cents. The two columns with no cents are the two that tie, which is what says rounding rather than a misread; the page does not state this and nothing here tests it further. THE GRAND TOTAL BLOCK ONLY -- the ~50 per-issue rows on this page are NOT transcribed.

rows.reconciliation: page 39, the row `GRAND TOTAL`: abatements 784,050.13 vs printed 784,050.13 ; adjustments -160,383.29 vs printed -160,383.29 ; balances 6,218,623.48 vs printed 6,218,623.48 ; committments 34,849,290.78 vs printed 34,849,290.78 ; forward 6,264,883.52 vs printed 6,264,883.52 ; payments -35,020,502.72 vs printed -35,020,502.72 ; refunds 84,886.33 vs printed 84,886.33 ; transfer -583,601.27 vs printed -583,601.27
rows.read_by: claude-opus-5 reading render_page.swift output at scale 4
rows.proof: Every row states an identity and closes on it: forward + committments + abatements + payments + refunds + transfer + adjustments = balances, 91 rows of 91. And all eight columns sum to the GRAND TOTAL the page prints on p39. NOTE, the town’s own heading: both pages are titled FY2021 COLLECTION OF TAXES above a table dated JUNE 30, 2024. The heading is stale; the figures are FY2024, as the levy years and the June 30 2024 date show.
